title: Bugs Bunny with Looney Tunes friends
description: A large central Bugs Bunny stands smiling with his hands clasped in front of his chest and one foot raised, wearing white gloves and showing his big white feet. To his left is a smaller Bugs Bunny with arms crossed, to his right is the Tasmanian Devil wearing a straw hat and standing on a bush, with several smaller cartoon characters, hearts, and butterflies around them on a painted background with colorful drips at the bottom.
